verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

segments.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, tell the ruler of Tyre that this is what the Lord GOD says: Your heart is proud, and you have said, ‘I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods in the heart of the sea.’ Yet you are a man and not a god, though you have regarded your heart as that of a god.

segments.text: “Son of man, tell the ruler of Tyre that this is what the Lord GOD says: Your heart is proud, and you have said, ‘I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods in the heart of the sea.’ Yet you are a man and not a god, though you have regarded your heart as that of a god.

verses.text: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you!

segments.text: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you!

verses.text: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained your wealth and amassed gold and silver for your treasuries.

segments.text: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained your wealth and amassed gold and silver for your treasuries.

verses.text: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, but your heart has grown proud because of it.

segments.text: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, but your heart has grown proud because of it.

verses.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you regard your heart as the heart of a god,

segments.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you regard your heart as the heart of a god,

verses.text: behold, I will bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and will defile your splendor.

segments.text: behold, I will bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and will defile your splendor.

verses.text: They will bring you down to the Pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.

segments.text: They will bring you down to the Pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.

verses.text: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who slay you? You will be only a man, not a god, in the hands of those who wound you.

segments.text: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who slay you? You will be only a man, not a god, in the hands of those who wound you.

verses.text: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. For I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.”

segments.text: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. For I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.”

verses.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

segments.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, take up a lament for the king of Tyre and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

segments.text: “Son of man, take up a lament for the king of Tyre and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

verses.text: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every kind of precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and emerald. Your mountings and settings were crafted in gold, prepared on the day of your creation.

segments.text: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every kind of precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and emerald. Your mountings and settings were crafted in gold, prepared on the day of your creation.

verses.text: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you. You were on the holy mountain of God; you walked among the fiery stones.

segments.text: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you. You were on the holy mountain of God; you walked among the fiery stones.

verses.text: From the day you were created you were blameless in your ways—until wickedness was found in you.

segments.text: From the day you were created you were blameless in your ways—until wickedness was found in you.

verses.text: By the vastness of your trade, you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mountain of God, and I banished you, O guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.

segments.text: By the vastness of your trade, you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mountain of God, and I banished you, O guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.

verses.text: Your heart grew proud of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor; so I cast you to the earth; I made you a spectacle before kings.

segments.text: Your heart grew proud of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor; so I cast you to the earth; I made you a spectacle before kings.

verses.text: By the multitude of your iniquities and the dishonesty of your trading you have profaned your sanctuaries. So I made fire come from within you, and it consumed you. I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the eyes of all who saw you.

segments.text: By the multitude of your iniquities and the dishonesty of your trading you have profaned your sanctuaries. So I made fire come from within you, and it consumed you. I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the eyes of all who saw you.

verses.text: All the nations who know you are appalled over you. You have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’”

segments.text: All the nations who know you are appalled over you. You have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’”

verses.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

segments.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, set your face against Sidon and prophesy against her.

segments.text: “Son of man, set your face against Sidon and prophesy against her.

verses.text: And you are to declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, and I will be glorified within you. They will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments against her and demonstrate My holiness through her.

segments.text: And you are to declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, and I will be glorified within you. They will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments against her and demonstrate My holiness through her.

verses.text: I will send a plague against her and shed blood in her streets; the slain will fall within her, while the sword is against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

segments.text: I will send a plague against her and shed blood in her streets; the slain will fall within her, while the sword is against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.text: For the people of Israel will no longer face a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.’

segments.text: For the people of Israel will no longer face a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.’

verses.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, I will show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations. Then they will dwell in their own land, which I have given to My servant Jacob.

segments.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, I will show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations. Then they will dwell in their own land, which I have given to My servant Jacob.

verses.text: And there they will dwell securely, build houses, and plant vineyards. They will dwell securely when I execute judgments against all those around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.’”
